title_zh: 先书面核对企业捐赠的标识条件

scenario.label_zh: 核对企业捐赠的标识条件
scenario.goal_zh: 核对捐赠方要求并约定先书面确认宣传标识条件

context_zh: 公益读书活动的组织者纳迪娅与企业联络人费利克斯核对一项虚构捐赠提议。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Thank you for offering a corporate donation. Would the money come with any conditions?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: The corporation I work for has a small community fund. My division can offer five hundred pounds.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Would you expect your logo on every book? We want to keep advertising out of the children's reading materials.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: No. A mention on the event poster would be enough, as far as I know.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: That sounds workable. Our main criterion for accepting support is that the donor cannot control which books we choose.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I understand, but I'll need to confirm that condition with our fund manager.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Please send us the conditions in writing before we accept the money.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I will. I'll include the poster request and your point about book selection.

targets.sense_zh: 判断或决定所依据的标准
